description: Be-verb omission repair (audit commit ad3641395). Rule en-be-verb-omission inserts the missing copula in beginner '<pronoun> very <adjective>' sentences: I -> am, He/She/It -> is, You/We/They -> are, across the adjective set happy/sad/tired/busy (optionally followed by 'today'). Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main.
fp_risk_note: The copula-insertion must fire only when the copula is genuinely missing. The negative cases stress: (1) already-correct sentences that already contain 'am/is/are' before 'very' — inserting again would double the copula; (2) adjectives OUTSIDE the supported happy/sad/tired/busy set (e.g. 'cold') — the rule must abstain rather than guess; (3) non-copula uses of 'very' such as 'very much' where no adjective follows; (4) inverted question forms ('Are you very happy?', 'Is she very tired?', 'Were they very busy?') where a fronted copula already exists — a previously-documented false positive (it yielded the double copula 'Are you are very happy?') that Lane A has since FIXED; these now lock the regression so it cannot reappear. A regression that broadens the pronoun/adjective match must re-check all of these.

positive.notes: First person -> 'am' (I very happy -> I am very happy).
Third person singular -> 'is' (He very tired -> He is very tired).

negative.notes: FP-stress (already correct): copula 'am' already present; rule must not double it.
FP-stress (adjective outside set): 'cold' is not in happy/sad/tired/busy, so the rule correctly abstains rather than guessing the copula.
FP-stress (non-copula 'very'): 'very much' is not '<pronoun> very <adjective>'; rule must not fire.

FP regression lock (question inversion): a fronted 'Are' already supplies the copula; the rule must NOT insert a second one. Previously fired -> 'Are you are very happy?'; fixed by Lane A. Verified no-fire on current main.
FP regression lock (question inversion): fronted 'Is' already supplies the copula. Previously fired -> 'Is she is very tired?'; fixed by Lane A. Verified no-fire on current main.
FP regression lock (question inversion, past): fronted 'Were' already supplies the copula. Previously fired -> 'Were they are very busy?'; fixed by Lane A. Verified no-fire on current main.
